title: Full Lances
subtitle: Mission 5 · 4 vs 4 · about 90 minutes
coachNotes: Every ’Mech in the box, four a side. Each side has one ’Mech of each size, so the lances are even.
Every rule so far is on: woods, hills, cover, rear shots, overheat, and punch or kick.
Rear weapons: the BattleMaster can still shoot a ’Mech behind it, as in Close Quarters. Pick Rear weapons before its forward shot.
New: Forced Withdrawal. A badly hurt ’Mech is crippled, and a crippled ’Mech heads home instead of fighting on.
Crippled means any one of: no armor left and Structure down to half or less (round up, so 5 Structure counts at 3); Medium and Long damage both 0 from weapon hits; or MP hits have stopped it moving.
The app marks a crippled ’Mech Withdrawing. Every turn it must move toward its own table edge. It doesn’t have to sprint, and it can still shoot or punch enemies in range.
A ’Mech that leaves the table, for any reason, counts as destroyed and can’t come back. When one drives off, open it and tap Left the table.
So a crippled ’Mech is worth chasing: catch it before it gets home, or let it go and it still counts as destroyed.
tableSteps: Use both maps side by side, or any open table about 3 feet across. Measure in inches and ignore printed hexes.
Put a hill near the middle and four patches of woods spread around it. Hills, cover, and woods work like Broken Ground.
The Awesome and BattleMaster share one card, front and back, and they’re on opposite sides. Give the card to one player; the other reads their ’Mech’s numbers in the app.
Keep a die or small token next to each ’Mech card to mark heat (0 to 3, then S). The app tracks it too.
Each side’s own short table edge is its home edge. A crippled ’Mech must head back toward it.
Each side places its four ’Mechs within 6 inches of its own short table edge. After the first dice roll, the winner picks which side places first; then take turns placing one ’Mech at a time.
winningSummary: Knock out all four enemy ’Mechs. A ’Mech that leaves the table counts as knocked out. If anyone is still standing after 10 turns, the side with more Structure left wins. Same Structure is a draw.

layout.openTable: No maps? Any open table about 36 × 22 inches works. Add the terrain where the diagram shows it.
